notes: All standard ML and plotting libraries are available locally.
SimBA itself is not installed, but its pipeline (pose -> engineered features -> Random Forest -> probabilities -> thresholded ethogram) can be reproduced faithfully with scikit-learn.

The provided 'features_extracted.csv' contains only the raw pose tracking columns (x,y,p for 8 body parts × 2 mice) plus two trivial frame-counter columns; we therefore engineer SimBA-style features (distances, velocities, rolling stats, mean confidences) ourselves to match the named pipeline.
